They explode across a few metres — accelerate, brake, cut, reverse — as confetti and torn paper tumble through the coloured light. One continuous shot with a slow dolly-out revealing the empty bowl; near the end the man surges at the lens and his upper body leaves the frame. Fans watch from the lit upper tier.

scene: Neon-lit Navi Mumbai stadium bowl, striped pitch, dark tiers, glowing perimeter light strips

caption: Golden hour turns a Nashik farmyard amber, cane bundles stacked against a leaning tin-roofed byre, dust blowing low across the packed dirt. Two adults stand fully in frame, sandals flat on the ground, and stay framed: a weathered Marathi farmer in his sixties, white shirt and dhoti, and a broad Nigerian woman in her thirties, headwrap and indigo dress. Within a few metres they spin fast, black umbrellas whirling and tilting, canopies catching the low sun as grit streams past their ankles. One continuous shot with a slow dolly-in toward them, unpolished and observational.

caption: Blue hour settles over a container yard lane at JNPT, corroded boxes stacked four high on both sides, gantry cranes silhouetted at the lane's end, faded lane numbers on the concrete paver blocks. Two adults begin fully in frame with feet on the pavers: a grinning Sri Lankan man around thirty in a yellow tee, and a tall Polish woman in her forties, blond ponytail, purple tank. They sprint fifty metres apart, hurling and catching a football on the run while paper scraps tumble between the stacks. One continuous shot, a camera craning down from high above to eye level; she finishes cropped at the knees.

caption: Storm-black sky presses on an open-air Kharghar festival stage, truss towers bare, torn banners snapping in the wind before the rain lands. Three adults hold the aluminium stage deck, fully in frame with feet on the metal and never leaving it: a compact Peruvian woman in gold, a tall Kenyan man in white, a stocky Russian man in blue. They tumble the deck's full width — round-offs, back handsprings, a stuck twisting flip — grinning as fabric whips overhead. One continuous shot from a static tripod camera at eye level; the audience surges behind the barrier below the stage lip.

scene: Open-air Kharghar festival stage, truss towers, torn banners, storm-black sky over the crowd barrier

caption: Harsh midday sun flattens a wide Alibaug tideline, a driftwood pile heaped near a weathered lifeguard tower, pale fireworks bursting almost invisibly over the water far out. One woman runs it: a powerfully built Trinidadian athlete around thirty-five, braids tied back, sunflower-yellow crop top and white shorts, wholly in frame with bare feet on the packed damp sand from the first second and framed the whole way. She charges thirty metres, hurdling driftwood, punching off one foot into huge long jumps, spray flicking up. One continuous shot from a static tripod camera at eye level. The beach is empty.
env_motion: fireworks bursting in the far sky
scene: Wide Alibaug tideline at midday, driftwood pile, weathered lifeguard tower, distant fireworks over water
